text:
Asha: Quick note  just posted launch blog + replay at 08:10. Want to run a tight inbox experiment for webinar registrants + inbound from the post. Goal: nudge first-success from 13% -> 18% in 10 days. Thoughts?

Ben: Suggested 3-arm inbox split randomized by signup_id:
- Arm 1: instant 25 credits + small starter modal
- Arm 2: templates-first email + inline tray (no credits)
- Arm 3: zero credits + 10-min office-hours invite + checklist
Keep per-user cap 30, global cap 5k.

Claire: Metric callouts: primary = pct_first_success_24h, secondary = pct_second_request_48h, tertiary = avg_tokens_consumed_week1. Events: signup.source, credit_grant, prompt_used, generation.success, office_hours_rsvp. I'll own the SQL and dashboard.

Dmitri: Routing: inbound from launch_post should add tag `inbox_launch_Q2`. Can eng add rule utm_campaign=="micro_inbox" -> onboarding_inbox_experiment? Need idempotency for credit grants.

Ops Bot: PR opened #1108: onboarding_inbox_experiment routing. Staging deployment scheduled.

Asha: Timing: prefer immediate grant for credit arm, templates arm could be 12h drip. Avoid too many timing variants. Email cadence: welcome, 12h nudge, 48h checklist.

Ben: Draft subjects: (credits) "25 credits to try starter prompts"; (templates) "10 templates to build faster"; (hours) "Join a 10-min office hours to get unstuck". Will post full bodies later.

Claire: QA checklist I'll run: cohort tag present, `credit_balance` increments and idempotency, sample 50 users per arm verify flow, dashboard event firing. Smoke scheduled 11:00 PT.

Dmitri: Add guardrail: if credit spend hits 80% of cap, auto-failover to templates arm. Eng to add routine.

Ops Bot: Failover rule queued (PR #1110).

Asha: Owners: Ben (copy + cadence), Claire (measurement + QA), Dmitri (routing + guardrails), Eng (implement grants). Target flip 09:00 PT tomorrow. Post any blockers here. :rocket:
